items.briefing:
An Australian bank has taken steps to block staff from sending confidential information to public AI tools, highlighting a growing concern for local organisations about data leakage through everyday AI use. This is a timely reminder that free AI chatbots may store or use the information you type into them, making them unsuitable for sensitive work data.

Samsung Galaxy S26 users in Australia are receiving the One UI 9 update — if prompted, it's worth installing promptly as updates often include important security fixes.

**Practical tip:** Never paste work documents, client details, or internal reports into public AI tools like free chatbots — use only organisation-approved alternatives.

featured.title: Bank blocks confidential data leaks to public AI tools
featured.summary: Hundreds of attempted uploads were stopped as a regional investment bank moved to curb analysts' use of public AI tools for sensitive data.
